title: Quantum graviton scattering with definite helicities in the null surface formulation, Part II: Third-order scattering and the exchange channels \author{C.~N.~Kozameh \and G.~O.~Depaola}
summary: We derive the graviton scattering map in the null-surface formulation (NSF) through third order in perturbations of Minkowski spacetime. The rational structure of the exact NSF equations allows a recursive perturbative construction of the cut function, conformal factor, and geometric sources. At third order, matching future and past null-surface reconstructions determines the cubic correction $δa^{\mathrm{out}}_{3,λ}$ to the outgoing graviton operators.
